model_annotation: The chart illustrates the average performance of different inference-based methods. The x-axis represents the method categories, labeled "Base," "CORG," and "AdaCAD," displayed in that order from left to right. The y-axis, labeled "Average Performance," is a linear scale ranging from 48 to 62, with tick labels spaced at intervals of 2. There are three bars representing each method category; the bars for "Base" and "AdaCAD" are colored gray-blue and the bars for "CORG" are colored blue. The "Base" method has three bars with approximate values of 49, 58, and 61, while the "CORG" method features bars with approximate values of 50, 59, and 60, and the "AdaCAD" method has bars with approximate values of 48, 57, and 62. No bars are visually emphasized beyond their color distinction, and the bars appear to be sorted by the order of the categories on the x-axis.
